name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI & Automation Implementation Specialist
summary: AI implementation and automation specialist with 5+ years architecting and deploying AI-driven workflows and automation systems for B2B service clients. Builds, tests, and documents multi-step automations in Zapier, Make, and n8n, including custom Python and JavaScript code steps, configures CRM and marketing-technology tenants end to end, and translates ambiguous business requirements into structured AI agent logic and reliable, documented workflows. Maintains rigorous implementation documentation and reusable templates across every engagement.

bullets: Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and reactivation.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, bridging business intent and reliable LLM output.
Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach.
Configure and evaluate AI-generated response output for client automation systems, and built rubric-based grading criteria for the SEO audit process, scoring outputs against defined standards.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment, managing workflows in ClickUp.
